svg.text: How the tensor T₂ encodes 2×2 matrix multiplication

g.text: T[a, b, c] = 1 means: "when computing matrix product, entry a of A × entry b of B → contributes to entry c of C"
T[a, b, c] = 0 means: "entry a of A and entry b of B don't interact for entry c of C"
The Tensor T₂ Visualized: 4 Slices Along Dimension a
Each slice shows: for a fixed aᵢ, which (b,c) pairs have T[aᵢ,b,c]=1
The AlphaTensor Game: Zero Out the Tensor
1. Start with tensor T (encoding matrix multiplication)
2. Each "move" subtracts a rank-1 tensor: uᵣ ⊗ vᵣ ⊗ wᵣ
3. Goal: Zero out T in minimum number of moves
This single multiplication covers 4 terms in the tensor!
